# Extend diagonal segments

Use this when non-background cells form one or more diagonal segments in an otherwise uniform grid, and the task asks implicitly to continue their lines.

## Procedure
1. Preserve the input dimensions and every existing colored cell.
2. Identify each straight diagonal segment, using step directions `(1,1)`, `(1,-1)`, `(-1,1)`, or `(-1,-1)`. Separate different segments and colors; do not assume the whole object is one line.
3. Continue each segment from its endpoints along the same diagonal direction into background cells, in both directions, until the grid boundary or a pre-existing non-background cell blocks the continuation. Never overwrite existing colors.
4. Emit a rectangular grid matching the original height and width. Check row and column counts before submitting.

## Demonstration-derived details
